# Photo export continuity

## Objective

Keep photo export usable while the new export engine is unfinished.

## Scope

Image-export fallback configuration and readiness of the new export engine.
Independent image-format examples are outside this effort.

## Ready work

Preserve a usable export configuration while engine development continues.

## Current state

The new export engine is unfinished; a preserved export configuration has not been selected.

## Areas and relationships

The current exporter can provide a fallback while the new engine is developed.
Configuration recovery and testing an actual image export establish different results.

## Dependencies

Switching to the new engine requires completed implementation and output checks.

## Blockers

The new engine is not ready; local configuration preservation can proceed.
